ValidationRule.description: GST needs the party's state to decide intra- vs inter-state tax (CGST+SGST vs IGST). The inbound Tally account pull fills BillingAddress__StateCode__s from the ledger state/GSTIN; this rule rejects any Tally_Account__c that still has no state.
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A Billing State/Province is required — it determines GST intra/inter-state (CGST+SGST vs IGST).
